caption: The drawing depicts a single human figure standing on a brown rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a light blue robe with a high collar and long sleeves, which are lined in bright red at the cuffs. The robe is decorated down the front with a wavy dark blue stripe and several orange or reddish circular dots. The figure’s right hand is holding the robe aside to reveal a bare leg, which is colored in light flesh tones with prominent red vertical streaks. The left hand is resting against the chest. The figure's face is light pink with red shading and simple black outlines for facial features; the hair is short and brown. The background is plain and beige. The number "36" is written in small print at the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 36: St. Roch: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico
